hooks.command: [ ! -f /tmp/promo-auto-pull-$(date +%Y%m%d) ] && git pull origin main --ff-only --quiet 2>/dev/null && touch /tmp/promo-auto-pull-$(date +%Y%m%d); true

REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && cd "$REPO" && git add bin/ src/ data/ docs/ .claude/ user-skills/ CLAUDE.md README.md install-skills.bat install-skills.sh 2>/dev/null; if ! git diff --cached --quiet 2>/dev/null; then git commit -m "auto: sync $(date +%Y-%m-%d)" && git push origin main; fi
